beats: My son typed grammar answers on his phone — zero of eight right in one sitting.
Three had the right word, killed by one stray typo. He gave up, started typing junk.
A keyboard was punishing spelling, not testing grammar.
I replaced typing with tapping — word chunks, shuffled with decoys, built in React. No keyboard, no typos.
It even recovers old exercises with no saved answer: seventeen of thirty, fixed automatically.
